The school-city of Rokka-also known as "Asterisk." Here boys and girls of the Starpulse Generation all compete in the Seibusai-the "star battle festival," fighting for glory on the greatest combat entertainment stage of the world. Ayato Amagiri has just arrived at one of these academies at the express invitation of its student council president, but when he begins his career by making a dangerous enemy, his life on Asterisk is off to a rough start!

description.en:
"O spirit destined to be mine, rise once more from the realm of the dead!"

In the depths of an extravagant tomb, Alice, a novice necromancer, channeled her mana into an ancient coffin as she cast her spell. Dust scattered through the air, and a wave of overwhelming mana surged, leaving her breathless. But what emerged was not the mindless undead she had expected—it was a handsome young man, casually perched atop the coffin, his piercing gaze meeting hers.

With a bright, disarming smile, he introduced himself—but Alice soon realized the truth: this was no ordinary man. He was the legendary figure who, centuries ago, had plunged the world into chaos and terror... the Demon King himself.

description.en:
In the immediate future, a giant meteorite has collided with earth. All living organisms, including mankind, have been wiped off the face of the planet. The government, who had foreseen this outcome, took measures to counter the worst-case scenario. In particular was Project “7 SEEDS”, in which five sets of seven gifted young men and women were carefully selected and placed into teams (Spring, Summer A, Summer B, Autumn and Winter). Each participant was then put under cryogenic sleep in hope of preserving the continued existence of mankind.  
  
When those men and women awoke, they found themselves suddenly thrust into a cruel world. While bereft and grieved over forever losing their loved ones, they sought to find ways to survive.
description.ru:
Учёные предсказали, что метеорит столкнётся с Землёй и человечество погибнет. Правительство каждой страны решило создать проект «7 семян». Каждая страна заморозила молодых и здоровых людей. Они должны были выжить после столкновения метеорита с Землёй и продолжить человеческую расу. Компьютер должен определить, безопасна ли Земля для существования людей и выпустить их в мир.  
  
Япония создала 5 групп и назвала их: «Зимняя», «Осенняя», «Весенняя», «Летние» группы «А» и «Б». Каждая группа состоит из 7 человек и одного проводника. У проводника были ампулы с ядом, чтобы они смогли умереть безболезненно, если бы ситуация стала невыносима. Для этих людей были приготовлены убежища, где были семена и книги — инструкции по выживанию.  
  
Шестнадцатилетняя девушка очнулась на тонущем судне. Она оказалась в компании незнакомцев, которые тоже не понимают, как оказались на этом корабле. У них одна задача — выжить!  
  
**7 Seeds won the 2007 Shogakukan Manga Award for shoujo manga.**

biography.en:
Yumi Tamura is a Japanese manga artist. Her debut short story, Ore-tachi no Zettai Jikan ("This is the Time for Us"), was published in 1983 in Bessatsu Shoujo Comic and received the 1983 Shogakukan Grand Prize for new artists.

She made her reputation with the long-running shoujo action/adventure series Basara, for which she won the 1993 Shogakukan Manga Award for shoujo manga. Her latest series, 7SEEDS, for which she won a second Shogakukan Manga Award for shoujo manga in 2003.
biography.es-la:
Yumi Tamura es una artista de manga japonesa. Su primera historia corta, Ore-tachi no Zettai Jikan ("Este es el momento para nosotros"), se publicó en 1983 en Bessatsu Shoujo Comic y recibió el Gran Premio Shogakukan de 1983 para nuevos artistas.

Se dio a conocer con la serie de acción/aventura shoujo Basara, de larga duración, por la que ganó el Premio Shogakukan de manga en 1993. Su última serie, 7SEEDS, por la que ganó un segundo premio Shogakukan de manga shoujo en 2003.

description.en:
Exhausted by her life as an overworked office worker, a young woman suffers an accident and awakens in a strange new world. The food and civilization seem almost identical to what she remembers, but its inhabitants certainly aren't: this is a world populated by humanoid beings with bizarre, inhuman heads. Even stranger, humans who appear in this world aren't treated as people at all. With no rights of their own, they're kept as rare and exotic pets. Unable to return home, the woman becomes “Ningen-chan,” the pet of Raz, a frightening-looking but surprisingly gentle and considerate Variant Head.

As Ningen-chan settles into her unusual new life, she finds herself increasingly drawn to her kindhearted owner, and Raz has developed feelings for her as well. Yet neither knows how to bridge the enormous divide between their species, not to mention the uncomfortable relationship of “owner” and “pet” that brought them together. In a world where their love shouldn't be possible, a lonely former office worker and her unusual new companion slowly grow closer in a sweet, slightly spicy interspecies romance.

This comedy depicts the romance between a quiet, day-dreaming female employee named Kie Hirano 
and Mitsumasa Koudai, a handsome male upper-tier employee just arrived from the New York branch. 
Despite having trouble talking with people, Hirano is suddenly invited to eat with Koudai for some reason.

description.en:
Is he an eccentric or a hermit? Does the seemingly unremarkable company employee, Fujii, redefine the definition of “happiness”?

In the workplace, he's a plain middle-aged man who doesn't stand out. While he does his job properly, he's not one to waste words. Come quitting time, he disappears like a ghost. He's not the type to be invited to after-work drinks in the first place. More like, he's the guy who's thought of as “I wouldn't want to end up like that…” by his juniors.

Yet, he piques the curiosity of others… “I wonder how he was raised?”, “Does he have friends or a girlfriend?”, “What does he do on weekends?”. Suddenly, you realize you've become captivated by Fujii…

description.en:
The manga is based on the "[This Man](http://www.thisman.org)" urban legend, which supposedly began when a woman living in New York told her psychiatrist in 2006 that she had been seeing the face of a man she had never met before in her dreams. Supposedly, more than 3,000 people all over the world have claimed to see "This Man" while dreaming. In present-day Japan, Hakaru Amano, an investigator who works with facial composites, is asked by a mother and daughter to draw the face of a man who illegally trespassed on their premises. He comes up with the face of "This Man".

The story of a serial killer begins to unfold.

description.en:
Veyron City—a mega-floating metropolis created from the discovery of new energy sources.

Shuu, a young man who owns and operates a small business in the area, leads a meager life due to his reckless spending. Kisara, a girl who visits Shuu's office and home because she is constantly concerned about him. She works while attending high school in Veyron City, doing everything from clerical work to housework. Ayano, Shuu's ex-girlfriend and a senior colleague at the corporation he had previously worked for, is also worried about him.

description.en:
A human girl falls into the demon realm and can't seem to communicate with the local demon Kuro who found her. Humans are rare in the demon realm and many would love to eat a human. However, Kuro ends up falling in love with her and names her Pochi!

Человеческая девушка попадает в мир демонов, лишенная возможности контактировать с местным населением, в том числе с нашедшим ее демоном Куро. Люди редко попадают в этот мир, и многие не отказали бы себе в удовольствии отобедать человеком. Тем не менее Куро понимает, что начинает влюбляться в девушку, и дает ей имя Почи.   
 Куро решает помочь Почи вернуться домой, а также защищает ее от демонов-людоедов. Девушка по мере нахождения в это странном месте начинает понимать здешний язык, но говорить на нем не может. После она встречает демона-принца, который также проявляет интерес к ее персоне. Так начинается их долгое путешествие в человеческий мир!

description.en:
When Yuiji overhears his classmate Yamato confessing to a friend that he's gay, he does his best not to let prejudice color his view, but still finds himself overthinking things. He especially notices the way Yamato looks at one particular boy: Yuiji's own best friend.

Even though he tries not to get involved, watching Yamato's one-sided love draws Yuiji in in a way he never expected. At first, he’s fueled by empathy, knowing that Yamato’s love interest is straight. But as his own friendship with Yamato deepens, Yuiji realizes how much he's come to care for his new friend. He just wants Yamato to be happy... and to be able to express his true self.
